title: This One Little Trick Will Prevent Claude From Hallucinating
description:
Claude doesn't go from perfect to hallucinating overnight. Here's the "canary" trick, one small instruction in your CLAUDE.md that warns you the moment a session starts to degrade, so you can reset before it wastes hours. Based on Peter Steinberger's agentic engineering playbook.

Get the full setup here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1pRH530jbDI8PpgGbZnntcWBuDPQjU7y7/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=110897400342351178452&rtpof=true&sd=true
